svg.text: K10-W ONE RAIL FOR STORAGE AND COOKING — dig boxes from the top
The cell's X axis runs 3.6 m; a hoist on the hand digs lidded boxes from top-opened stores.
W1: one carriage, 5th motor = hoist · storage modules end at z ≈ 1350
top box ≈ 15–20 s · deep box: minutes unless pre-dug from the menu plan
K10-W1, FRONT VIEW of the whole machine (fronts and OEM doors removed)
K10-W2: a second small carriage on the same rails
X box: ONE rail pair over 3.6 m (dry cover over storage)
K10 cell: bay · domino · cooker · dishwasher

g.text: suction-cup stem tool: lid to the rack
digging: top box to the other stack

svg.text: the hook rod opens it — no hatch motor;
the latch releases on power loss
first touch: the hooks snap under
they open. No motor in the gripper.
blue: storage carriage (X belt, short Y, hoist; ≈ €300) → box shelf

g.text: 1/6 The hand runs along the same rail to the freezer; its hook rod lifts the hatch lid and a solenoid latches it open
2/6 Digging: the hoist's toggle gripper moves the box on top to the neighbouring stack
3/6 The wanted box is lifted out through the hatch; the latch releases and the spring shuts the hatch
4/6 Along the same rail to the cell's box shelf; a suction-cup stem tool parks the box lid in the lid rack
5/6 Variant W2: a small second carriage on the same rails digs while the cell carriage cooks; storage stays full height
6/6 Result: whole machine ≈ €3.0–3.6 k instead of ≈ €7.5 k; €2 k for the whole machine at 93 % was not found
